metadata.case_name: LAM MAN YIN v. CHOY TAK FU

plaintiff.occupation_before: pig farmer in the New Territories

injuries.description: Multiple lacerations over the face, right arm and right foot with resulting scars
source: He had a laceration on the face, right arm and foot. There is a neat 3" scar running down the right cheek, it is not noticeable and difficult to distinguish from the normal lines on his face. There is a 2" neat scar on back of the right forearm.
1. Multiple lacerations over the face (5 cm.), right knee (4 cm.); (3) Multiple abrasions over the right foot and right arm.

injuries.description: Degloved injury of right calf and ankle treated with skin grafts; donor site scars on front of both thighs; healed graft areas on right calf and right heel
injuries.body_part: right calf; right ankle; front of both thighs (donor sites); inner aspect of right heel
source: He suffered a laceration of the right calf and ankle and these were skin grafted, taking skin from the front of both thighs. There is a 5" × 3" flat scar, the donor areas on the front of each thigh. There is a 9" scar running down the front of the calf, 1½" wide at its widest point where the skin was applied. The graft took well and the area is healed and healthy and there is a 1" ×1½" area on the inner aspect of the right heel which also received a graft and the skin is firm and healthy.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

injuries.description: Fracture of the medial lateral condyles of the tibia (weight-bearing bone of the lower leg) in the knee joint with healed deformity and permanent abnormality
injuries.body_part: right knee / tibia (medial and lateral condyles)
source: He suffered a fracture of the medial lateral condyles of the Tibia, the weight bearing bone of the lower leg in the knee joint.

X-Ray shows that the lateral condyle is broadened and the medial condyle slightly depressed. The bone at the knee is widened by ½". I enclose a drawing of the present position of the healed fractures, no improvement will take place.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified fracture of upper end of tibia

injuries.description: Periarthritis of the right shoulder due to trauma with restriction of movement (reduced range of motion, loss of internal rotation)
source: He also complains of pain and restriction of movement of the right shoulder. He can only raise the arm from the side through 100o instead of being able to raise it straight in the air through 180o. He has lost 20o of the movement of internal rotation of the arm at the shoulder; this is the movement in which a man puts his hand behind his back and loss of this movement makes taking on and off of a jacket and shirt awkward, X-Ray of the shoulder shows no abnormality but he has a periarthritis of the shoulder due to trauma and restriction of movement frequently lasts for a year to 18 months but usually recovers spontaneously; however as he is 70 he is unlikely to get a full recovery.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: Multiple abrasions over the right foot and right arm
source: (3) Multiple abrasions over the right foot and right arm.

manifestations.description: Walks with a limp leaning on his stick
Gross wasting of the right thigh muscles
Right knee joint is swollen; the circumference is 13½" as opposed to 12¾" on the left and the lower leg is displaced laterally below the knee by ½"
Pain and restriction of movement of the right shoulder; limited abduction to 100° and loss of 20° internal rotation making taking on and off of a jacket and shirt awkward
He is quite incapable of performing the arduous work that he was doing at the time of the accident
1" ×1½" area on the inner aspect of the right heel which also received a graft and the skin is firm and healthy (healed graft area)
Neat 3" scar running down the right cheek and 2" neat scar on back of the right forearm
At present he has a 6% Impairment of the Whole Man from loss of right shoulder joint movement which will gradually improve
By aged 80 he will have a 10% Impairment of the whole Man from osteoarthritis of the right knee

treatments_received: skin grafting (right calf/ankle; donor sites front of both thighs)
use of two crutches for a period and later one walking stick

losses.description: Walks with a limp and requires a walking stick
Permanent scars and skin graft donor site scarring on thighs and grafted areas on right calf and heel

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Loss of 20° internal rotation of the right shoulder making taking on and off of a jacket and shirt awkward
Has not been able to resume pig farming since the accident and is incapable of performing the arduous work he was doing prior to the accident
